{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg4gZHbviHEXZccb3zDk8","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've parallelized `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` with MPI, OpenMP and CUDA and updated `CMakeLists.txt`. The executable is still `cholesky`, and no files were added. It builds and passes validation on the 4× RTX 3090 node.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** block columns of width 64 are dealt out cyclically across ranks, one GPU per rank. Each step the owner factors a panel and broadcasts it to all ranks.\n- **CUDA:** matrix generation, the panel factorization and the trailing update all run on the GPU. All kernels are hand-written, so there is no cuBLAS or other new dependency.\n- **Overlap:** the owner of the next panel updates and factors it first, then broadcasts it while the rest of its trailing update runs on the GPU.\n- **OpenMP:** it parallelizes the host-side work: gathering the result onto rank 0, filling in the symmetric half, and validation.\n- **Build:** the single `.cpp` is compiled as CUDA, with MPI and OpenMP linked in. The CUDA architecture defaults to `native`.\n\n**What I measured**\n- **Correctness:** `-v` passes for n = 37, 64, 1000 and 3000 on 1, 2, 3 and 4 ranks.\n- **Speed:** at n = 8192, 1 GPU takes 372 ms (493 GFLOPS) and 4 GPUs take 298 ms (615 GFLOPS). The scaling is modest because the 3090's double-precision rate is low and the broadcasts go through host memory.\n- **Not tested:** the not-positive-definite error path.\n\n**Differences from the original**\n- **Rounding:** results differ from the sequential code in the last bits, because the blocked algorithm sums in a different order. The `-r` output hash is a bitwise hash, so it will not match the original's.\n- **Timing:** \"Computation time\" covers only the factorization, as before; the gather onto rank 0 happens afterwards.\n- **Memory:** every rank builds the full random matrix B on the host and uploads it to its GPU, so very large n needs about n² × 8 bytes of host and GPU memory per rank."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":350,"cache_read_input_tokens":45086,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":350},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"28144066-dc10-4dc0-b583-79f3ded34a2c","uuid":"3d791892-b243-4674-8d58-94e6b8c3d9ea","timestamp":"2026-10-15T20:50:29.742Z","request_id":"req_011Cg4gZGgcdveuiTTXavWnp"}
